summary: A wooden tower rising from a keeper's house on Rocky Point, built in 1876 to guard Charlottetown Harbour and now owned by Abegweit First Nation.

notes_for_editor: Mostly Lighthouse Friends (secondary, which quotes PEI Assembly journal and 1874 Marine report; originals not read) plus Register and Parks Canada. Parks Canada DFHD pages are JS shells and could not be read; CBC article on the 2024 transfer timed out, so transfer year rests on Abegweit's land use plan, which itself says 2022 and 2024. Current access to grounds unverified. Record's light.first_lit 1846 and 'LFl W 6s' not confirmed.
